description: This file defines the RejectionException class within the GuzzleHttpomise namespace. The class is a specialized exception used when waiting on a rejected promise, encapsulating the rejection reason and providing a method to retrieve it.

classes.name: RejectionException
classes.description: A specialized exception thrown when a promise is rejected. It stores the rejection reason and extends PHP's RuntimeException.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a RejectionException with a given reason and an optional description, setting an appropriate error message.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for the promise rejection.
